description: This file defines a Flutter UI page named HomePage, implementing a StatefulWidget that composes various widgets to build the main screen of a food delivery app. It sets up an AppBar with a notification icon and navigates to SignInPage on icon press, and displays search, menus, popular foods, and best food widgets within a scrollable layout, along with a bottom navigation bar.

classes.name: HomePage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that represents the main home screen of the app.

classes.name: _HomePageState
classes.description: State class for HomePage that builds the widget's UI, including AppBar, scrollable content, and bottom navigation.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomePage, including AppBar, body with multiple widgets, and bottom navigation bar.
